GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 091.31 (2 Aug 51) ESS/FTC
(SCAPIN - 2162)
APO 500
2 August 1951
MEMORANDUM FOR : Japanese Government
SUBJECT : Authority to Sign Agreements Between Japan and Germany
1. References are:
a. Final draft, dated 23 July 1951, of Payments Agreement between Germany and Japan.
b. Final draft, dated 23 July 1951, of Trade Agreement between Germany and Japan.
c. Final draft, dated 25 July 1951, of Germany - Japan Trade Plan for period 1 July 1951 - 30 June 1952.
d. Final draft, dated 25 July 1951, of letter from Vice-Minister for Foreign Affairs of Japan to President of the German Delegation regarding the understanding of the term "services" as employed in the foregoing agreements.
e. Final draft, dated 25 July 1951, of letter from Vice-Minister for Foreign Affairs of Japan to President of the German Delegation relating to most-favored-nation treatment.
f. Final draft, dated 25 July 1951, of letter from Vice-Minister for Foreign Affairs of Japan to the president of the German Delegation regarding the applicability of the provisions of the foregoing agreements to the United States, United Kingdom and French Occupied Sectors of Greater Berlin.
g. Final draft, dated 25 July 1951, of letter from Vice-Minister for Foreign Affairs of Japan to President of the German Delegation regarding invoicing in Deutscher Mark and in Japanese Yen.
2. The documents, reference paragraph 1, above, were negotiated by representatives of the Government of Japan at the German Trade Conference held under the chairmanship of the Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers in Tokyo, Japan, which ended on 26 July 1951.
3. The Government of Japan is hereby authorized to sign and exchange with the Government of the Federal Republic of Germany formal documents which embody the text of references paragraph 1, above, for the purpose of establishing agreements which both parties desire to be effective upon the coming into force of peace treaty between the Allied Powers, or any of them, and Japan.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
/s/ K. B. Bush
/t/ K. B. BUSH,
Brigadier General, USA,
Adjutant General
